datasets.name: Landslide and debris flow dataset
datasets.source: Z. Chao, C. Zhenyu, S. Fenghuan, Z. Zhen, and Y. Changxi
datasets.verbatim: All experiments are conducted on the landslide and debris flow dataset [53]. The dataset has high-resolution remote-sensing images of landslide and debris flow disasters in Sichuan Province, China, and surrounding areas since 2008.

methods.name: Channel transformer encoder module (CTEM) and multiscale global attention module (MSGAM)
methods.summary: The proposed method is an end-to-end abnormal region segmentation model consisting of a backbone, a Channel Transformer Encoder Module (CTEM), and a Multiscale Global Attention Module (MSGAM). The CTEM models long-range dependencies using a transformer encoder, while the MSGAM integrates low- and high-level features using dilated convolutions and the CTEM to extract multiscale global context.
methods.source: Weichao Cai, Weiliang Huang, Lin Tian, Chao Huang, and Jingwen Yan
methods.verbatim: In this article, we propose a novel method for abnormal geological region segmentation in high-resolution RSIs. Specifically, the proposed method consists of two modules: a channel transformer encoder module (CTEM) and a multiscale global attention module (MSGAM).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced only by a citation number without a link or public availability, and the custom code for the proposed method is not provided or linked.
